_comment: Local-only Emulator Suite config for `npm run emulators`.
Declares all three databases so the mobile app and the Operator Portal can
be developed together against one emulator. Run with --project demo-accessbelt
(the demo- prefix makes it impossible for the emulators to reach production).
This file must never be passed to `firebase deploy`; CI deploys firebase.json only.
The operator rules path points into the separate, gitignored Operator-Portal repo.
